text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Mmh. I sensed a bottomless presence and 
followed it, but... it seems to end here.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...No. Faint though it may be, I can feel 
it. What is this curiously tranquil 
presence...?"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...No, what nonsense are you thinking, 
Yaeno Muteki. It is mere foolish 
drivel..."
